name: typography
title: Typography
description: Role-based display, heading, body, label, caption and code text.

files.content:
'use client'
// Generated from Moru UI source. Do not edit. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
import { createElement, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react'
import type { TypographyRole } from './_theme/tokens'
import { cn } from './_lib/cn'

type TypographyElement =
  | 'h1'
  | 'h2'
  | 'h3'
  | 'h4'
  | 'h5'
  | 'h6'
  | 'p'
  | 'span'
  | 'div'
  | 'label'
  | 'strong'
  | 'small'
  | 'code'

export type TypographyProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> & {
  variant?: TypographyRole
  as?: TypographyElement
}

const defaultElements: Record<TypographyRole, TypographyElement> = {
  display: 'h1',
  heading: 'h2',
  body: 'p',
  label: 'span',
  caption: 'span',
  code: 'code',
}

/** Text styling is independent from document hierarchy; choose `as` for the context. */
export function Typography({
  variant = 'body',
  as,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: TypographyProps) {
  return createElement(
    as ?? defaultElements[variant],
    {
      ...props,
      className: cn('ui-typography', className),
      'data-role': variant,
    },
    children,
  )
}
